additional.text: 2-Piece Bonus
Increase [Earth] elemental damage by +25%.
4-Piece Bonus
Hitting an opponent with a Special Skill will apply the [Plant Tether] effect self and opponents in a radius. If the Special Skill is either [Water] or [Earth] element, the duration increases to max.
The effect will also apply to nearby allying summons. Any damage dealt by them will be considered lifedrain damage while they possess the effect.

[Plant Tether] Debuff/Buff - When hit with [Water] or [Earth] attacks, increase resistance to those elements by +75%, but lifedrain damage (health damage over time effects) from any source will increase by +150%  (Duration: 3 sec min, 10 sec max).
Description
A legendary Tier 5 artifact with a core for its latent plant powers. Spreading to form a suit, the extent of plant-based magic is enhanced substantially, but just beware of fire though.

paragraphs: The equipping character does not deal any elemental damage on their own Skills, instead, outgoing normal damage is buffed by +50%.
Opponents’ resistance to normal attacks will automatically be ineffective when the equipping character attacks.

reference_sections.title: 4-Piece Bonus
paragraphs: Increases defense by +20% and gained [Shield] effect from sources will additionally heal 5% of max health. Any gained [Shield] will contribute to an even more increased normal damage equivalent to each percentage gained in respect to equipping character’s max health, up to +100% max.

reference_sections.title: Description
paragraphs: A prototype armor based on a more secret design. The armor can amplify the physical extent of one’s attacks but may not channel magic well. When fused with more power (harder to come by) the potential is amplified.

reference_sections.title: 4-Piece Bonus
paragraphs: When any ally goes below 10% of their max health, heal that ally for 10% of equipping character’s max health once, granting [Invincibility], and then decrease own health by -20% of max health. This effect can be activated once per 30 seconds and can be lethal to self if having less than the required amount of health remaining.
[Invincibility] Buff - Become immune to incoming damage for 6 seconds.
